text: The authors assume that in each debate round an agent updates its Dirichlet parameters by adding the counts of answers chosen by its neighbours (Definition 2), so each debate round is a Bayesian conjugate update of the Dirichlet-Multinomial model.
title: Debate modelled as Bayesian count update from neighbours' answers
